## Hypothesis

The WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate (buy ITM-2 weekly options at 1-2 DTE on same directional signal) claims a structural DTE edge: longer DTE reduces theta bleed while preserving directional capture. The LEADERBOARD states "1-2 DTE finding stands (OOS $59-66/tr, p<=0.045)" from `test_multiday_dte_compare.py`. This analysis validates that claim across four non-overlapping quarters using the Stage-1 kitchen runner (BS-synthetic pricing).

## OP-20 Disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Stage-1 uses BS-synthetic pricing with fixed qty (not scaled to account). Real 1-2 DTE weekly premiums ~2.33× 0DTE ATM ($3.81 vs $1.63 per VWAPCONT study) → 57% fewer contracts at same risk. At $2K account, min-3-lot floor may bind.

2. **Sample bias:** 225 trades over 6 quarters (2025-Q1 to 2026-Q2) on BS-synthetic pricing. **NOT real OPRA fills.** Selection: all BEARISH_REJECTION + BULLISH_RECLAIM signals that fire. Overfit risk: single 2026-Q1 quarter drives all positive P&L (+$1,549 vs -$2,482 other three quarters).

3. **Out-of-sample:** This IS the walk-forward OOS across 4 quarters (2025-Q3, Q4, 2026-Q1, Q2). Result: **INCONSISTENT** — only 1/4 quarters positive, aggregate negative (-$934). Sharpe not computable from Stage-1 output (no daily returns series).
